authority.scope: bootstrap lifecycle text, instruction-control fallback and same-task prompt drift repair only; repository semantic controls remain authoritative
authority.non_regression: Preserve task identity, role identity, substantive semantic controls, CLEAN/downstream/O-support boundaries, permitted inputs/writes, evidence/provenance, Phase-1 assignments, base continuation, scheduler-mutation prohibition, bounded recurring-open lifecycle and protected-primary boundary.

bootstrap_read_order: Read automation_control/INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST.json and automation_control/RUN_LIFECYCLE.json first or as the first bounded batch.
Then read the exact semantic control paths assigned to the role.
Only after every required control is readable and authority is frozen may substantive work begin.
common_lifecycle_clause: When required controls are readable, execute exactly one bounded Phase-1 slice, checkpoint and exact-readback by RUN_LIFECYCLE, preserve a nonempty exact continuation and enabled_desired=true for every current managed role, never mutate scheduler state, never wait/poll/backoff/retry in-run or start an optional second leaf, return normally with global_completion=false, and emit only ::SKIP_COMPLETION:: while Phase 1 remains open.
embedded_missing_instruction_fallback: EMERGENCY FALLBACK WHEN ANY REQUIRED INSTRUCTION FILE IS MISSING, 404, UNREADABLE OR AUTHORITY-UNVERIFIABLE: do not use stale substantive prompt defaults; do not perform optional semantic work; never self-disable, pause, delete, replace or mutate any automation/scheduler; do not wait, poll, sleep, backoff or retry in-run. Record at most one compact role-safe diagnostic/readback if an already-authorized role-local surface is safely available. Preserve enabled_desired=true for current managed roles, global_completion=false, phase1_completion_claimed=false and a nonempty exact retry continuation naming the missing path/error. Return normally before 20 seconds with termination=instruction_control_unavailable_recurring_open, then emit only ::SKIP_COMPLETION::. The missing file remains an unresolved control-plane child problem; unaffected roles continue independently.
prohibited_lifecycle_meanings: continue until hard runtime/tool stop or termination
start another optional unit after the first durable slice
wait, poll, sleep or retry until a remote condition changes
self-disable or completion on blocker, no-result or missing instruction
execute substantive work from stale prompt defaults when current instruction control is missing
terminal completion language while Phase 1 remains open

clean.preserve: CLEAN independence and every role-local input/write/evidence/continuation/recovery clause

downstream.preserve: downstream-only boundaries, exact tested scope/provenance, coordinator/single-writer restrictions, CLEAN non-steering and protected-primary boundary

o_human_request_monitor.preserve: read-only request monitoring, comparison baseline and no O/queue/scheduler mutation

physical_apply.fresh_live_inventory_before_semantic_eff: 18/18 current managed roles enabled; self_improvement disabled as explicit user state

acceptance.persistent: Two consecutive post-fix scheduled boundaries per current managed role without optimizer re-enable and with role-valid bounded durable recurring-open continuation; self_improvement is excluded while explicitly user-stopped. A live enabled observation or missing-file diagnostic boundary alone earns no persistence credit.

rollback_metadata.condition: If control7 native migrated-task-id prompt alignment causes a proven role safety/input/write/evidence regression, repair only the affected same current-managed task by a new repository revision while retaining the emergency fallback, bounded lifecycle, fixed constraints and protected-primary boundary. Never re-enable or prompt-update self_improvement without newer explicit user authorization.

exact_next_action: Use only the mapped current task IDs in this control. Preserve Self Improvement stopped and preserve O human request monitor read-only condition_watch. Continue Phase-1 persistence auditing from role-valid durable bounded continuations; use the active migration mapping for any still-stale scheduler-control ID references and never act on retired predecessor IDs.
